updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP – Protection for Excluded Windows Folders
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now extends protection to files in commonly excluded Windows folders like Temp and AppData, improving coverage for sensitive data that might previously have been overlooked. This helps admins enforce consistent data protection policies across the entire endpoint.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP – User-Scoped Just-In-Time Audit
updates.summary: Admins can now target Just-In-Time audit generation to specific users or user groups, reducing audit noise and focusing compliance efforts on high-risk populations. This granular control improves audit efficiency and reporting relevance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Expansion for Copilot+ PC Recall Snapshots
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP is extending to Copilot+ PCs to protect against capture of windows containing restricted sensitivity labels and sensitive information types in Recall snapshots. Admins can now author custom policies to control what content Windows Copilot+ can retain.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Automated Cleanup for Departed Users
updates.summary: Admins can now automatically delete both content and containers (OneDrives and mailboxes) of departed employees at scale, helping maintain regulatory compliance without manual intervention. This reduces the operational burden of offboarding and improves data hygiene.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention Based on Last Access Time
updates.summary: Admins can now apply retention labels and policies to OneDrive and SharePoint items based on when they were last accessed, enabling more granular data lifecycle management. This capability helps organizations retain frequently-used data longer while disposing of stale content sooner.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention for Microsoft Planner
updates.summary: Data lifecycle management capabilities now extend to Microsoft Planner, allowing compliance admins to create retention policies for tasks and plans associated with Microsoft 365 Groups. This closes a gap in managing compliance across collaborative workloads.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: DLP policies now protect sensitive data at rest in non-Microsoft applications like Box and Google Workspace using existing Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and the same classification engine as Microsoft 365 locations. This extends consistent data protection governance beyond the Microsoft ecosystem.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels – Auto-Labeling Simulation Mode
updates.summary: Admins can now run auto-labeling policies in simulation mode to preview which items would be labeled without making changes, reducing the risk of unintended bulk labeling. This safe testing capability enables better policy validation before enforcement.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitivity Labels for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies now extend to non-Microsoft apps including Box and Google Workspace, using the same classification engine available for Microsoft 365 locations. This unifies sensitivity labeling governance across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
updates.summary: DLP now extends to Microsoft Cowork, enabling admins to enforce a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork to prevent sensitive labeled data from being used in AI interactions. This protects sensitive AI conversations by blocking restricted knowledge sources and sensitive information types.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Policy Insights with Security Copilot
updates.summary: Security Copilot can now summarize and provide insights on DLP policy coverage including locations, classifiers, and notifications, helping admins identify gaps and maintain alignment with organizational data protection posture. This AI-assisted capability reduces manual policy review burden.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Insights and Policy Recommendations
updates.summary: Admins now receive insights on sensitive M365 data in OneDrive and SharePoint along with retention policy recommendations to improve data governance and security posture. This guided approach helps organizations make informed decisions about sensitive data retention.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP – Archive File Classification Behavior Alignment
updates.summary: Archive file classification behavior on Windows endpoints is being updated to align with cloud workloads, improving consistency and reducing noise in event reporting while enhancing performance. This standardization simplifies management and reduces false positives.
